Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_years>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

<document id=DOC_employment_dates>
Backend Engineer, Northwind Systems, 2011 to 2018.
Senior Backend Engineer, Corvus Data, 2018 to present.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

The summary does not state years of experience. Where you derive the figure
from employment dates, state the requirement minimum with a plus rather than
the full calculated total.

response.text: Backend engineer with 8+ years of experience across transactional services, most recently building and maintaining a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
